reason: The reviewer identifies the identical mechanism: inside the setSets functional updater, stateFor(lift) closes over the outer render-scope `sets` variable rather than reading from the updater's own `s` parameter, so when two same-lift updates are batched, both invocations compute from the same stale pre-batch value and the second overwrites the first. This is the same root cause (stale-closure read instead of `s`) and the same resulting behavior (silent clobbering of one of two batched same-lift edits) as the ground truth, just phrased with more implementation detail (naming keyFor/seedFor).
